data.name: Football Club Manager 26 LIVE
data.detailed_description:
Compete in daily fixtures against real managers in evolving Game Worlds where every decision matters. From transfers and tactics to trophies and relegation battles, your choices shape your legacy.

INCLUDED EXTRAS

This edition comes with the Multi-World Upgrade Pack, giving you access to three Game Worlds at once.

MANAGERIAL CAREER

Your reputation grows with every result. Climb the ladder, earn global recognition, and unlock opportunities to manage the biggest clubs in the world.

AUTHENTIC MATCH ENGINE

Matches play out in detail with live stats, possession zones, and tactical insights. React in real time to injuries, red cards, and weaknesses in your opponent’s setup to gain the upper hand.

SMART TRANSFER MARKET

Control your budget, scout talent, and sign players who fit your philosophy. From bargain gems to headline stars, every deal shapes the future of your squad.

DAILY PvP ONLINE MATCHES

The whistle blows daily: one league fixture to test your tactics, and cup matches waiting for those who earn the right to compete.

EVER-EVOLVING GAME WORLDS

No two Game Worlds are the same. Clubs rise and fall, players change hands, and the landscape shifts with every season. Shape the future of your club and leave your mark on a constantly evolving football universe.

WATCH EVERY MATCH, ANYTIME

You can watch matches unfold in real time, even if your club isn't involved. Goals and highlights are available to view on demand, so you'll never miss a moment of action across the league.

data.short_description: Multiplayer football management built on fair competition. Outsmart rivals with skill and strategy - no random packs, no pay-to-win gameplay. Take charge of your club, build your squad, and prove yourself on the world stage.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Portuguese - Portugal

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 or AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel GMA X4500, NVIDIA GeForce 9600M GT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
